_about: Story mode (Sam, 2026-10-06: build the story mode proposed in analysis/story/PROPOSAL.md, after Super Smash Bros. Melee's Adventure Mode). Eight chapters, one per region of the road (road.region.<region>), each a short run of scenes. A scene names fights from data/road.json by stop id, so each opponent brings its pilot, weapon, companion and ground from there. kind: duel (one fight), waves (its fights one after another), hold (stay in the round for hold_s seconds). Each fight is one round unless rounds says otherwise, on a clock of fight_seconds; a lost fight, or one that runs out of time, costs a life and plays the scene again from its first fight; with no lives left the chapter starts over with lives restored. giant: the opponent is half again its size (content::story::GIANT). The stage to cross and the team fight in the proposal come in a later build.
